nodes.description: Public sale activation flag; toggled by owner via flipSaleState and required by mintBaddies.
Presale activation flag; toggled by owner via flipPresaleState and required by presaleMint.
Counter of tokens minted during presale; compared against MAX_PRESALE with a raw addition.
Pseudo-random starting index used to shift token metadata; set once by setStartingIndex.
Provenance hash string set by the owner through setProvenanceHash.
Constant maximum supply of 8765 tokens enforced in mint and reserve paths.
Constant maximum number of presale tokens (2346).
Constant maximum tokens per public mint transaction (10).
Constant per-address presale allocation (3).
Constant mint price of 0.08765 ether per token.
Constant number of tokens (65) reserved for the owner.
Mapping of addresses allowed to participate in the presale; populated by addToPresaleList/removeFromPresaleList.
Mapping tracking per-address presale purchase counts against MAX_PRESALE_PURCHASE.

edges.reason: flipSaleState toggles the SALE_ACTIVE flag.
flipPresaleState toggles the PRESALE_ACTIVE flag.
addToPresaleList writes whitelist entries into PRESALER_LIST.
removeFromPresaleList clears whitelist entries in PRESALER_LIST.
isPresaler reads PRESALER_LIST for the queried address.
presalePurchasedCount reads PRESALE_PURCHASES.
setProvenanceHash stores the provenance hash.
setBaseURI updates the ERC721 base URI storage.
setStartingIndex writes STARTING_INDEX.
transferOwnership rewrites the _owner storage variable.
owner() reads the _owner storage variable.
mintBaddies requires SALE_ACTIVE to be true.
mintBaddies enforces the MAX_SUPPLY cap.
mintBaddies enforces MAX_PURCHASE per transaction.
mintBaddies multiplies BADDIE_PRICE by the token count to check msg.value.
mintBaddies computes supply + i with an unchecked raw addition.
mintBaddies calls _safeMint for each minted token.
mintBaddies mints tokens to the caller msg.sender.
Loop counter i feeds the raw supply + i addition.
mintBaddies caches totalSupply into the local supply variable.
presaleMint requires PRESALE_ACTIVE to be true.
presaleMint requires the caller to be present in PRESALER_LIST.
presaleMint checks per-address allocation in PRESALE_PURCHASES.
presaleMint compares PRESALE_MINTED against MAX_PRESALE.
presaleMint enforces the MAX_PRESALE cap.
presaleMint enforces the MAX_SUPPLY cap.
presaleMint enforces MAX_PRESALE_PURCHASE per address.
presaleMint multiplies BADDIE_PRICE by the token count to check msg.value.
presaleMint uses msg.sender for whitelist checks and mint recipient.
presaleMint performs the unchecked PRESALE_MINTED + numberOfTokens addition.
presaleMint performs the unchecked PRESALE_PURCHASES[msg.sender] + numberOfTokens addition.
presaleMint calls _safeMint for each minted token.
presaleMint caches totalSupply into the local supply variable.
presaleMint increments PRESALE_MINTED inside the mint loop.
presaleMint increments PRESALE_PURCHASES[msg.sender] inside the mint loop.
withdraw transfers the whole balance to msg.sender via transfer.
The local balance variable is the amount forwarded in the transfer.
Value transfer hands control and funds to the untrusted msg.sender.
reserveBaddies uses NUM_TO_RESERVE as the mint count.
reserveBaddies checks the reservation against MAX_SUPPLY.
reserveBaddies mints the reserved tokens to msg.sender.
reserveBaddies calls _safeMint in its reservation loop.
setStartingIndex derives pseudo-randomness from blockhash.
The blockhash-derived value is stored into STARTING_INDEX.
setStartingIndex reverts if STARTING_INDEX is already non-zero.
tokenURI branches on whether STARTING_INDEX has been set.
tokenURI adds tokenId and STARTING_INDEX with an unchecked operation.
tokenURI reads the base URI when composing metadata.
tokenURI assigns the shifted id to the local id variable.
_safeMint mints the token through _mint before the receiver check.
_safeMint invokes _checkOnERC721Received after minting.
_checkOnERC721Received performs an external call to the recipient contract.
The recipient's onERC721Received callback executes while _safeMint is still in progress.
onlyOwner guards flipSaleState.
onlyOwner guards flipPresaleState.
onlyOwner guards addToPresaleList.
onlyOwner guards removeFromPresaleList.
onlyOwner guards withdraw.
onlyOwner guards reserveBaddies.
onlyOwner guards setStartingIndex.
onlyOwner guards setProvenanceHash.
onlyOwner guards setBaseURI.
onlyOwner guards transferOwnership.
onlyOwner compares msg.sender with owner() to authorise execution.
msg.sender is used as the key when checking PRESALER_LIST eligibility.
msg.sender is used as the key when reading and incrementing PRESALE_PURCHASES.
The constructor initializes ERC721 metadata and ownership context.

normalization_plan.reason: The public mint token count parameter only exists to size the loop and cap checks of mintBaddies.
The presale token count parameter is consumed entirely by presaleMint checks and loop.
The entries array parameter is iterated only inside addToPresaleList.
The entries array parameter is iterated only inside removeFromPresaleList.
The queried address parameter is used solely by the isPresaler view.
The provenance hash parameter is written directly to PROVENANCE by setProvenanceHash.
The base URI parameter is forwarded to _setBaseURI only by setBaseURI.
The token id parameter is only consumed by the tokenURI lookup and index shift.
The cached supply local is a temporary inside the mintBaddies loop.
The cached supply local is a temporary inside the presaleMint loop.
The loop counter i is the operand of the raw supply + i addition in the mint loop.
The per-iteration entry local is a temporary inside the addToPresaleList loop.
The balance local is the exact amount transferred by msg.sender.transfer in withdraw.
The id local holds the result of the tokenId + STARTING_INDEX addition in tokenURI.
